column1: # ZAP baseline triage (tab-separated: rule id, IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL, reason). Run WITHOUT -I so an untriaged WARN fails.

column3: (Dangerous JS Functions) htmx ships a documented eval path that is disabled by allowEval:false and blocked by the CSP (no unsafe-eval)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) by design: Fetch Metadata + Origin checks (tower-http CsrfLayer) and SameSite=Lax cookies, see guides/security.md#csrf
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre) COEP is deliberately unset: require-corp breaks third-party embeds; COOP and CORP are set
(Storable and Cacheable / Non-Storable Content) informational: public pages and /static are meant to be cacheable, authenticated responses and redirects are no-store
(Authentication Request Identified) informational: a sign-in form, once an authentication sample adds one
(Session Management Response Identified) informational: the session cookie
